decisions.reason: The compact rotating dumper extends the firm's core construction range and still has its own page, so the investment and visible commitment favor keeping it.
The articulated dumper builds on established competence and remains prominently presented, so it fits the firm's announced direction.

Its website presence fell from its own page to a mention and it is distant from the core, but the heavy development investment and the claim of being an innovative specialist push management to persist and attribute weak results to the long sales cycles of mining.
A multi-model telescopic loader line is a substantial, visible commitment close to the core business, which makes dropping it very unlikely.
The material lift line is close to the core, is reported as the most popular lift in rental, and just won a large order.
The underground loader has its own page and a quantified field success of 1,000 operating hours in 7 months, which justifies continued commitment despite its distance from the core.
